snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 - Slaanesh Reveal Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 is coming to PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S in 2026! Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115160/Warhammer_40000_Boltgun_2/

In this new gameplay trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2, get an exclusive first look at the Daemons of Slaanesh and Death Guard you'll face as you carry out your duty to purge heretics in the name of the Emperor!
